origin: C11 reached 100R (fixed 2-4-8 42.6% vs AKI-chosen 2.8%) but the two use different numbers of points. Owner 2026-11-21 02:14: keep PAPER as it is and pre-register a SAME-POINTS comparison before deciding.

owner_decision.decision: HOLD (PAPER trifecta formation unchanged) until C25 decides
owner_decision.owner_words: 今のまま、同じ点数での比較を事前登録して判断を先に延ばす

change_under_test: PAPER 三連単: in each race, the same number of points as the AKI-chosen formation, chosen as (a) the AKI-chosen formation [current], (b) the best trifecta combinations by the PAPER Harville probability, (c) fixed 2-4-8 cut to that number in Harville order.
learning_races: 2026-11-13..20 PAPER 260R (in-sample; designed after seeing these races)
production_change: NONE. PAPER and formal tickets unchanged.
venue_rule: same direction in >= 2 venues with >= 12 races each

candidates.hypothesis: At equal points, choosing trifecta combinations by probability beats the AKI-chosen formation shape.
candidates.primary_metric: PFS and hit races at equal points (AKI_CHOSEN vs TOPN_HARVILLE vs F248_TOPN), top-1 race share
candidates.promote_if: at 100 races TOPN_HARVILLE (or F248_TOPN) PFS exceeds AKI_CHOSEN by >= 10 points with more hit races and top-1 share < 40% -> decision packet to the Owner on the PAPER trifecta selection
candidates.reject_if: at 100 races AKI_CHOSEN PFS >= both alternatives
